ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity mass across the central and medial regions; high-intensity contiguous blobs located at the lateral distal tips; multiple sparse high-intensity focal spots (mottling) scattered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a clearly defined vertex and a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with variable pixel-amplitude (approx. 5-20 pixels) along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from convex near the median notch to slightly concave toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme lateral points of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented at multiple angles across the central-dark region and right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) and heavy barnacle colonization on the lateral margins; small semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe (viewer's left).
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity texture on the extreme lateral boundaries caused by protruding biofouling (barnacles) creating an irregular silhouette.
